name: Android (Kotlin)
leftForYou: Add the SDK to the app module as the quickstart describes (https://voidhash.com/docs/sdks/kotlin/quickstart), if the agent could not: implementation("com.voidhash:voidhash:<version>") from Maven Central.
Build the app, or run 'voidhash integrate --check "./gradlew :app:assembleDebug"' to have it checked.
Connect Google Play and map your products to Play products before you sell for real: 'voidhash provider --help'.
